problem: The official full test suite grew from 419 passed on 2026-08-03 to 1031 passed at the measurement commit, roughly three days later. Execution takes about six seconds, so run cost is not the issue. The issue is how tests are attached: repository state such as record counts, exact file names and a single bundle fingerprint is pinned inside test asserts, and these pins blocked three legitimate, human-approved changes on 2026-08-05 and 2026-08-06. The reason a state is frozen lives only in the failing assert, with no machine-readable declaration. At the same time 1031 tests provided zero coverage of design section 1.3, and a fabricated record timestamp was caught by review rather than by any test. The Development Policy states that growth in commit, test or record counts alone must not serve as a quality proxy.
impact: each legitimate second record required editing a pinning test in the same change, three times in two days
the rationale for a freeze is only recoverable from a test assert, so relaxing it requires archaeology instead of reading a declaration
test volume creates an impression of coverage while a designed check (section 1.3) had no test at all
a record-integrity failure (fabricated recorded_at) passed the whole suite and was caught only by review
dead-weight tests that never detect anything cannot be told apart from load-bearing ones without mutation measurement
boundary: preserve this observation as immutable source
do not treat this observation as an Improvement Candidate, Human Triage Decision or Issue Record
do not delete, rewrite or reorganize any test on the basis of this observation alone
do not advance Work 8 or start mutation measurement on the basis of this observation alone
